incorrectQuestions.question: Which TWO statements correctly contrast Amazon SNS with Amazon SQS? (Select 2)
options: A) SQS sends push notifications directly to SMS and mobile devices
B) SNS follows a push model (one-to-many), while SQS follows a pull model (one-to-one consumption)
C) Pairing SNS with multiple SQS queues enables a fan-out architectural pattern
D) SNS persists messages in queues for up to 14 days by default
incorrectQuestions.explanation: SNS is push-based and enables fan-out; SQS is pull-based where consumers poll and delete messages[cite: 8].

incorrectQuestions.question: When running Apache HBase on Amazon EMR, where can the HBase root directory be durably stored to achieve high durability and decouple storage from compute?
options: A) Ephemeral EC2 Instance Store volumes
B) S3 Glacier Deep Archive offline vaults
C) Virtual Tape Library backed by AWS Storage Gateway
D) Amazon S3 using the EMRFS storage mode
incorrectQuestions.explanation: EMR supports running Apache HBase directly on Amazon S3 via EMRFS, providing durable storage with 11 9's of durability and lower storage costs[cite: 3].

incorrectQuestions.question: Which of the following is NOT true regarding AWS Direct Connect as described in the handbook?
options: A) Establishes a dedicated, private network connection from on-premises to AWS[cite: 8]
B) Automatically encrypts all network traffic by default without configuration
C) Provides port speeds ranging from 50 Mbps up to 100 Gbps[cite: 8]
D) Bypasses the public internet to deliver consistent performance and lower latency[cite: 8]
incorrectQuestions.explanation: Direct Connect is a dedicated private connection, but traffic is unencrypted by default unless MACsec or an IPsec VPN is layered on top[cite: 7, 8].

incorrectQuestions.question: Which TWO AWS resources can have an AWS WAF Web ACL attached directly to them? (Select 2)
options: A) Network Load Balancers (NLB) operating in pure TCP mode[cite: 7, 8]
B) Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive vaults
C) Amazon CloudFront distributions[cite: 8]
D) Application Load Balancers (ALB) and Amazon API Gateway REST APIs[cite: 8]
incorrectQuestions.explanation: AWS WAF attaches to CloudFront, Application Load Balancers, API Gateway, AppSync, and Cognito User Pools (not raw TCP NLBs)[cite: 8].

incorrectQuestions.question: What is the maximum configurable delay for new messages added to an SQS Delay Queue?
options: A) 15 minutes
B) 24 hours
C) 12 hours
D) 14 days
incorrectQuestions.explanation: SQS Delay Queues postpone delivery of incoming messages for a configurable period between 0 seconds and 15 minutes[cite: 8].
